capabilities: Tag images via a right-click context menu
Select tags visually from existing tags
Manage image tags in a sidebar tab
Store tags, author, and dates in frontmatter
Rescan the vault for existing image tags
extras: The manifest description says tags are stored in plugin settings, while the README says they are stored in frontmatter (YAML); the README also notes that a closed tag manager tab can be reopened from the plugin settings.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to tag images visually; assigning tags to an image normally requires typing them manually.
summary: Visual image tagger that adds right-click tagging for images and a sidebar manager, storing tags, author, and dates in frontmatter.
